draft.title: Social responsibility in marketing
card: Social responsibility in marketing means a business treats its customers fairly and honestly. It does not only think about making sales.
promoting products as better for the environment, such as using recycled packaging. The claims must be true.
Making false or exaggerated environmental claims to win customers is called greenwashing. It misleads customers, so it is not responsible.
A business holds customers' private details, such as addresses and payment information. Acting responsibly means keeping them secure and using them only as customers agreed.
draft.remember: Responsible marketing means honest claims and protecting customers' private data.

a.q: A shop labels its bags 'made from 100% recycled plastic' but they are made from new plastic. What is this?
opts: Greenwashing, because the claim is false
Green marketing, because it mentions recycling
Data protection, because it informs customers
Loyalty marketing, because it targets repeat buyers
a.why: Green marketing needs true claims. Saying bags are recycled when they are not misleads customers, which is greenwashing. Mentioning recycling alone does not make a claim responsible.

b.q: Lena runs an online shoe store in Perth. Which action shows she is protecting her customers' private data?
opts: Keeping payment details secure and using them for orders only
Selling customer email addresses to other businesses
Sharing customer addresses on the store's social media
Keeping all customer details on an unlocked shared computer
b.why: Protecting data means keeping it secure and using it only as customers agreed. Selling, sharing or leaving details unsecured puts customers' privacy at risk.
b.clue: Look for secure storage and use only as agreed.

a.q: A shop labels its bags 'made from 100% recycled plastic' but they are made from new plastic. What is this?
opts: Greenwashing, because the claim is false
Green marketing, because it mentions recycling
Green marketing, because plastic bags can be reused
Data protection, because it informs customers
a.why: Green marketing needs true claims. Saying bags are recycled when they are not misleads customers, which is greenwashing. Mentioning recycling does not make a claim responsible if the claim is false.

b.q: Lena runs an online shoe store in Perth. Which action shows she is protecting her customers' private data?
opts: Keeping card details secure and using them only for orders
Using buyers' emails for ads they never agreed to receive
Selling customer emails to a trusted partner business
Storing all customer details on an unlocked shared computer
b.why: Protecting data means keeping it secure and using it only as customers agreed. Sending ads customers never agreed to is tempting because Lena keeps the data herself, but it still uses their details in a way they did not agree to.
b.clue: Check both how the data is stored and how it is used.

a.best: Greenwashing, because the claim is false

b.best: Keeping card details secure and using them only for orders
